AI agents on this computer, like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex or Cursor, can set JobFinder up for you: job searches, the AI filter, AI instructions, free AI keys and the scan schedule. They read the app’s Help too. Only this computer can connect, and only with the token.
Another program uses port 47822, so agents can’t connect. Close it and restart JobFinder.
Copy the setup for your agent
Add it to the app’s MCP settings, for Cursor ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
Copied. It holds the token: paste it only into your agent. %1$s
Then ask the agent: “Set up JobFinder for me.”
Agents set up with the old token stop working until you copy the setup again.
New token made. Copy the setup again for your agents.
